CivitForge

Open-source forge platform. API running on this server.

API Status

REST API v1 available at /api/v1/

Operational

Quick Start

# Login / Register
curl -X POST http://HOST:9091/api/v1/auth/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"alice","email":"alice@example.com","display_name":"Alice"}'

# Create a repo
curl -X POST http://HOST:9091/api/v1/repos \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"my-project","description":"My repo"}'

# List repos
curl http://HOST:9091/api/v1/repos \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN"

API Endpoints

GET /api/v1/health
POST /api/v1/auth/login
GET /api/v1/auth/me
GET /api/v1/repos
POST /api/v1/repos
GET /api/v1/users
GET /api/v1/search?q=...
